svg.text: Cutting b×b Squares Never Changes Which d-Grids Tile the Remainder
Loop invariant: Div(x) ∩ Div(y) = Div(y) ∩ Div(x mod y) ⇒ refinement type Gcd(x, y) is identical at every step
Geometric Preservation Lemma: x = q·y + r ⇔ an x×y rectangle = (q squares of side y) + (remainder r×y)
• Forward (d ∣ x ∧ d ∣ y ⇒ d ∣ r): Since d tiles y, d automatically tiles every y×y square.
Removing q tiled y×y squares from a tiled x×y rectangle leaves r = x − q·y tiled by the exact same d-grid.
• Backward (d ∣ y ∧ d ∣ r ⇒ d ∣ x): Gluing q tiled y×y squares onto a tiled r×y rectangle tiles x = q·y + r.
Therefore Div(x) ∩ Div(y) = Div(y) ∩ Div(r) — no valid tile size is ever gained or lost!
Trace A: (12, 8) → (8, 4) → (4, 0) [ Common tile sizes fixed at {1, 2, 4} throughout ]
Trace B (3 Cuts): (30, 18) → (18, 12) → (12, 6) → (6, 0) [ Common tile set {1, 2, 3, 6} preserved at every cut ]
